import BusyBeaver.ZFC.Bisim254
import BusyBeaver.ZFC.NativeTheory254

import BusyBeaver.ZFC.DirtyProgram254
import BusyBeaver.ZFC.Permutation252Frame
namespace SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC
open RegisterPath RMBisim Bisim254
#print axioms t1_eq
#print axioms t2_eq
#print axioms start_ok
#print axioms all_ok
#print axioms start_ok'
#print axioms all_ok'
#print axioms prog254_halts_iff
#print axioms literal_halts_iff
example (R : Registers) : Halts Prog254.program ⟨[], R⟩ ↔
    Halts RMEquiv254.pathDag254 ⟨[], R⟩ := prog254_halts_iff R
example : Halts Prog254.program Prog254.initial ↔
    BProv NativeTheory254.NativeAx [] Form.fBot :=
  literal_halts_iff.trans NativeTheory254.c254_refutation_iff
example (h : BProv PSCCalibration.ZF0Ax [] Form.fBot) :
    Halts Prog254.program Prog254.initial :=
  literal_halts_iff.mpr (QuotientZF0.c254_of_zf0_refutation h)

def corruptPositive : CTree → CTree
  | .empty => .empty
  | .leaf (a, b, _, k) => .leaf (a, b, 3010, k)
  | .branch n l r => .branch n (corruptPositive l) r

def corruptZero : CTree → CTree
  | .empty => .empty
  | .leaf (a, b, j, _) => .leaf (a, b, j, 3010)
  | .branch n l r => .branch n (corruptZero l) r

-- Both successor references of the actual first decrement entry are tested.
example : entryOk t1 t2 (corruptPositive cert) (1, 1, 3010, 2) = false := by decide +kernel
example : entryOk t1 t2 (corruptZero cert) (1, 1, 1, 3010) = false := by decide +kernel
example : RMBisim.decode 4 = [false, false] := by decide +kernel
example : RMBisim.decode 5 = [false, true] := by decide +kernel

private theorem encoded_zero (i : Nat) :
    L2.enc ⟨0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0⟩ i = 0 := by
  rcases i with _ | i
  · rfl
  rcases i with _ | i
  · rfl
  rcases i with _ | i
  · rfl
  rcases i with _ | i
  · rfl
  rcases i with _ | i
  · rfl
  rcases i with _ | i
  · rfl
  rcases i with _ | i
  · rfl
  rcases i with _ | i
  · rfl
  rcases i with _ | i <;> rfl

theorem zero_literal_native :
    Halts Prog254.program Permutation252Frame.zeroRoot ↔
      BProv NativeTheory254.NativeAx [] Form.fBot := by
  have he : L2.enc ⟨0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0⟩ =
      Permutation252Frame.zeroRoot.registers := funext encoded_zero
  have h := (prog254_halts_iff (L2.enc ⟨0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0⟩)).trans
    (DirtyProgram254.six_nonformula_path_iff 0 0 0 0 0 0)
  simpa only [he, Permutation252Frame.zeroRoot] using h
#print axioms zero_literal_native
end SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC
